map.标准差大一定不好吗？: Is a Large Standard Deviation Always Bad?
map.取决于场景。制造业追求一致性，标准差越小越好；但投资与创新类场景波动本身是特性。: It depends on the scenario. Manufacturing values consistency, where a smaller standard deviation is better; but in investment and innovation work, variability is itself a feature. Judge together with the distribution shape: with a long tail (a few very slow requests) the standard deviation is inflated, and then P95/P99 is more intuitive and maps more directly to user experience.
